_source: switch et depot all shops.txt — extract 30-06-2026, matched to Odin shopId 2026-08-24
_precedence: The per-shop entry below is authoritative. chainSwitchRules is context for a human only: never answer a customer from a chain rule when the shop entry is absent or TO CHECK — hand over instead.

_statuses.switch: YES = the shop allows swapping ski/snowboard during the stay. NO = it does not. TO CHECK = unknown, hand over to a human who contacts the shop.
_statuses.depot: YES = the shop offers overnight storage. NO = it does not. TO CHECK = unknown, hand over to a human who contacts the shop.
_statuses.depotBookableOnline: true = the overnight-storage option can be booked directly on alpy.com. Rare. Unrelated to the modelchange option.

_coverage.note: A shopId absent from shops{} means no data: hand over, never guess.
